messages:
alex: quick sync — i'm doing a profiling pass for token-level latency breakdowns + GPU utilization summaries for routes. saw a weird spike on /chat-stream where tail token latency doubled but avg SM occupancy stayed flat. trying to figure out if it's kernel selection or kv cache churn. anyone looked at per-route token p95/p99 recently?

maria: saw that too last night. p50 unchanged, p95 up on long contexts (>2048). maybe kernel fallback to slower matmul path when sequence > 1024?

derek: can you paste the example trace? i want the perf trace + profiler flame.

alex: pasted below — trimmed trace from perfbot aggregator. note the two phases: token dispatch spikes and then small stalled gaps.

```
# perfbot trace snippet
route: /chat-stream
model: gptx-8b-quant
sequence_len: 4096
token_latency_ms: [0.8, 1.2, 1.1, 1.3, 15.6, 16.0, 0.9, 1.0]
notes: kv_cache_miss_count=4, kernel_variant=gemm_fp16_fallback
```

sasha: kv_cache_miss_count x4 for that session — might be prefetch miss + KV eviction thrash. if prefetch logic is keyed on average seq len it can under-prefetch for outliers.

maria: also saw MIG-level power/thermal flaps on host-12 around the same time. could be throttling causing kernel to take longer despite occupancy looking steady. we need per-MIG SM occupancy and power curves instead of host-aggregate.

alex: agreed. infra-bot, can you attach GPU per-MIG metrics for host-12 around 03:40 UTC? specifically: sm_occupancy, vram_used_bytes, gpu_power_watts, gpu_temp_celsius, and mig_slice_util_pct.

infra-bot: attached: /artifacts/host-12/gpu-metrics/1769123000-1769124000.csv (CSV has per-MIG 5s resolution)

derek: thanks. i'm going to sketch two dashboard changes:
- add token-level latency histogram panel grouped by route+model (p50/p95/p99 + tail rate)
- add GPU per-MIG panel with SM occupancy heatmap + power/thermal overlay

maria: for metrics instrumentation, propose these PromQL-ish queries to add to perf exporter and dashboards:
- token generation latency p99 per route:
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(token_generation_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))
```
- kv cache miss rate per route:
```
sum(rate(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) by (route, model)
```
- MIG SM occupancy (percent) per slice:
```
avg_over_time(gpu_mig_sm_occupancy_percent{host=~"host-.*"}[5m]) by (host, mig_slice)
```

derek: add a derived metric: token_tail_penalty = p99_token_latency / p50_token_latency per route. that'll help flag regressions automatically.

alex: nice. can perfbot compute token_tail_penalty and emit an alert when > 4 and errors > 0.5% for 10m? also correlate with `kv_cache_miss_total` and `gpu_temp_celsius` in the alert runbook.

perfbot: created metric `route_token_tail_ratio` and rule `route_token_tail_alert`. will ship to staging next deploy.

sasha: small UX ask: in Grafana overlay the kernel_variant timeline (from runtime profiler) on top of token latency chart so you can see when fallback kernels started. Kernel tags are `kernel_variant=fast_attention` or `kernel_variant=gemm_fallback`.

maria: agree — that would make root cause obvious. also add a per-route sample waterfall that shows kv cache hits/misses per token. short hops are super helpful.

alex: action items:
1) derek: add dashboard panels + derived token_tail_penalty metric (ETA EOD)
2) maria: add per-MIG metrics to exporter and the PromQL queries above (ETA tomorrow)
3) sasha: instrument kernel_variant timeline and kv hit/miss labels in traces (ETA 48h)
4) perfbot/infra-bot: push data to /staging/grafana/dashboards and enable route_token_tail_alert in staging (ETA next deploy)

maria: i'll also run a synthetic workload with skewed long contexts to reproduce. will post results in this thread.

alex: perfect. if the alert fires in staging we should run a canary rollback policy for the model variant and route to avoid customer impact. tagging @oncall for visibility. :eyes:

sasha: noted. thanks everyone.

alex: thanks — will follow up with a short doc for runbook steps and dashboard links once panels exist.
